findings.title: D4 deletes pyc of manifest path not import path
cache_from_source can raise
Re-import by eviction leaves other modules' `import apps.x as m` references on the old module
findings.why_it_matters: Importers holding the module object keep old code after eviction; the ledger said behavior was unchanged and the docs didn't mention it.
findings.recommended: A: Keep re-import by eviction. Fix the Assumed bullet, and state in the reload docs that a module another app holds as a module keeps the old code until that app reloads.
findings.chosen: A: Keep re-import by eviction. Fix the Assumed bullet, and state in the reload docs that a module another app holds as a module keeps the old code until that app reloads.

findings.title: `load_class` takes the first live instance's type as the key's class without checking it against the manifest
findings.why_it_matters: A surviving instance from before a rename would hand new instances the old class.
findings.recommended: A: Reuse the live class only when its name and module match the manifest; otherwise fall through to the loader. Add a test with a mismatched manifest.
findings.chosen: A: Reuse the live class only when its name and module match the manifest; otherwise fall through to the loader. Add a test with a mismatched manifest.
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut and listed to the user before the walkthrough; implemented via the instance's app_manifest path and class name.

findings.title: A dropped `force_reload` is logged only at DEBUG, so a Reload can report success while old code runs
findings.why_it_matters: A per-instance Reload after an edit reports success while keeping old code, with nothing at INFO.
findings.chosen: Raise the 'Ignoring force_reload' log to INFO and reword it to name the cause and the fix.

findings.title: D3 and the factory-to-loader forced path have only mocked tests
findings.why_it_matters: Nothing ran the factory, registry and loader together for D3 or forced reloads.
findings.chosen: Add integration tests against a temp apps dir with a real registry and loader for sibling-key reload, reload_app after an edit, and reload_instance with a live sibling.

findings.title: Nothing pins that the content hash is read before the import
findings.why_it_matters: A refactor moving the hash read after the import would pass every test.
findings.chosen: Add a loader test that saves the file between the hash read and the import and asserts the next forced load re-imports.

findings.title: Whether a class load already failed is read in two layers, and the error is fetched from the cache in a second call
findings.why_it_matters: The failure rule lives in the loader and a mirror in the factory; pre-existing shape.
findings.recommended: B: Keep the two-layer read as Build call 3 ratified. The structure predates this change.
findings.chosen: B: Keep the two-layer read as Build call 3 ratified. The structure predates this change.
findings.choice_reason: Auto-picked as clear-cut (pre-existing, outside the minimal-scope posture) and listed to the user before the walkthrough.

findings.title: Re-importing a module drops a stopped sibling key's cached class, so the config view loses its schema
findings.why_it_matters: A stopped sibling's config view over-masks until it loads again.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: after a sibling key's reload re-imports a shared file, a stopped key's config view masks every string until that key loads again.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: after a sibling key's reload re-imports a shared file, a stopped key's config view masks every string until that key loads again.

findings.title: A plain import can record the new file's hash over stale bytecode, and then the gate reports "unchanged"
findings.why_it_matters: A same-second same-size edit plus a restart can run stale bytecode that Reload reports as unchanged.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: a same-size edit saved in the same second as the last compile, then plain-imported by a fresh process, runs stale bytecode that a Reload reports as unchanged until the file is saved again.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: a same-size edit saved in the same second as the last compile, then plain-imported by a fresh process, runs stale bytecode that a Reload reports as unchanged until the file is saved again.

findings.title: Records are keyed by manifest path while modules are identified by name, and dependents have no record
findings.why_it_matters: Two path spellings get two records; #4498 must rekey.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: records are keyed by manifest path, so two path spellings for one module get two records, and #4498 rekeys when it adds dependent records.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: records are keyed by manifest path, so two path spellings for one module get two records, and #4498 rekeys when it adds dependent records.

findings.title: A cached failure is re-raised as the same exception object, so its traceback grows each time
findings.why_it_matters: Repeated plain loads of a failed module grow its traceback until a forced load.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: a cached load failure re-raised on repeated plain loads accumulates traceback frames until the next forced load replaces it.
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation: a cached load failure re-raised on repeated plain loads accumulates traceback frames until the next forced load replaces it.
